title: Two Skiers in Winter Gear Standing in Snow, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th-century snapshot capturing two men standing in fresh snow dressed in winter ski attire. They are equipped with ski goggles, hooded windbreakers, heavy trousers, leather ski boots, poles, and skis carried over the shoulder. In the snowy background above a stone wall, a partial Italian sign reading 'tessuti · filati' is visible.
